$description:
Layout dimensions that more than one thing must agree on. THIS FILE IS NOW EMPTY, and it is kept for the record of why — twice now a dimension has been given a semantic token here and twice it turned out not to be an agreement between anything.

The last two went on 2026-08-15: `sidebar.width` and `sidebar.width-collapsed` were demoted to tier 3 as `--sidenav-width` / `--sidenav-width-collapsed` (migrations.json: sidebar-width-to-sidenav-width). Their $description claimed "15 readers" and the real number was ONE COMPONENT — esa-sidebar-nav, which is what tier 3 is for. The name was additionally shared, at a different value, with the `.sidebar` layout primitive's own 18rem knob in src/layouts.css; the demotion hands that name to the primitive outright and closes a collision logged three times in the ledger.

BEFORE ADDING A DIMENSION HERE, note the pattern both deletions share: the reader count was assumed, never counted. A dimension token nothing reads cannot be re-pointed to any effect, so it is a theming surface that only appears to exist. Count the readers first, and if the answer is one component the token belongs in component-tokens.css.

Five earlier siblings were deleted on 2026-08-14 — header.height, footer.height, content.max-width, content.narrow-width, content.wide-width — because every one had zero readers: not a component, not layouts.css, not the docs site, not the spoke template, not cb-fish. A dimension token nothing reads cannot be re-pointed to any effect, so it was a theming surface that only appeared to exist (system-improvement-ledger.md, P2).

They were not superseded by a rename; they were never wired up, and the components that would have used them answered the question differently:

  - Header and footer heights: esa-app-bar and esa-app-shell set no height at all. They are content-sized, which is the kit's model as of Change 9 — a px height cannot grow with rem text, so re-introducing one here would re-create the defect that change removed.
  - Content widths: esa-container and esa-app-bar each take a maxWidth PROP defaulting to a hardcoded 1556px, which matches none of the deleted 1200/800/1440. The token layer lost that argument long ago; deleting it stops the system claiming a lever it does not have.

NOTE that 1556px is now the only answer, and it is a literal in four places across two components. That is a real defect and it OUTLIVED this deletion — see the ledger.
